story.title: Milo and the Lost Color
story.text:
SC01_ST01_N = Milo is a little chameleon.
SC01_ST02_N = He loves to change colors–green, blue, red!
SC02_ST01_N = But one morning, he wakes up gray.
SC02_ST02_N = "Oh no!
SC02_ST03_N = Where is my color?"
SC02_ST04_N = Milo says.
SC02_ST05_N = He looks at his tail.
SC02_ST06_N = It's still gray.
SC02_ST07_N = He feels sad and shy.
SC03_ST01_N = Milo walks into the forest.
SC03_ST02_N = He sees a yellow butterfly.
SC03_ST03_N = "Can I have your color?" he asks.
SC04_ST01_N = The butterfly smiles.
SC04_ST02_N = "My color helps me fly."
SC04_ST03_N = Milo smiles back.
SC04_ST04_N = "Then I will keep looking."
SC04_ST05_N = He waves goodbye.
SC05_ST01_N = He meets a red flower.
SC05_ST02_N = "Can I have your color?"
SC05_ST03_N = Milo asks.
SC05_ST04_N = The flower says, "My color helps the bees find me."
SC06_ST01_N = Milo is sad.
SC06_ST02_N = "Everyone has their own color."
SC06_ST03_N = He sits by a blue pond.
SC06_ST04_N = He cries.
SC06_ST05_N = A tiny drop falls into the water.
SC07_ST01_N = The pond shines!
SC07_ST02_N = Milo sees many colors in the water–red, yellow, blue, green.
SC07_ST03_N = They mix and dance like a rainbow.
SC08_ST01_N = Milo laughs.
SC08_ST02_N = "Maybe my color is inside me!"
SC08_ST03_N = He takes a deep breath and closes his eyes.
SC08_ST04_N = His body starts to glow.
SC09_ST01_N = Green!
SC09_ST02_N = Then blue!
SC09_ST03_N = Then red again!
SC09_ST04_N = Milo's colors come back, brighter than before.
SC09_ST05_N = He feels happy and warm.
SC10_ST01_N = Milo runs home.
SC10_ST02_N = He looks in the mirror.
SC10_ST03_N = "I found my color.
SC10_ST04_N = It's me!" he says proudly.

sentences.text: He loves to change colors–green, blue, red!
But one morning, he wakes up gray.
"Can I have your color?" he asks.
The flower says, "My color helps the bees find me."
He sits by a blue pond.
A tiny drop falls into the water.
Milo sees many colors in the water–red, yellow, blue, green.
They mix and dance like a rainbow.
He takes a deep breath and closes his eyes.
Milo's colors come back, brighter than before.
